text: I for one am glad prompt injection is getting solved across the industry and that Astra is not only our most capable, but also our most aligned model to date. But also ...

quoted_tweet.author: Boris Cherny
quoted_tweet.text:
I am pleased to see that OpenAI’s new model is roughly on par with Gemini Flash and Opus 4.8 on prompt injection risk. Nice work!

Evaluating and naming other labs turns out to be a great way to encourage them to train more aligned models. We will continue to do this until other labs pay more attention to safety. This is good for everyone and there is a lot of room left to go!

We solved prompt injection in practice for Claude models about two months ago. But prompt injection is a significant security risk no matter what model you use, and it is important that the industry similarly spends more effort to train their models to be resistant to prompt injection, among other elements of model alignment.

As models become more capable and central to businesses and economies, the risks only increase. We should be taking them seriously, and doing the right thing for our customers and the world.

text:
I am pleased to see that Ant’s new Claude Code has a version of background computer use on par with the version from Codex from last May this year. Nice work!

Shipping great features first turns out to be a great way to encourage other labs to ship too. We will continue to do this until other labs pay more attention to shipping. This is good for everyone and there is a lot of room left to go!

We solved computer use in practice for GPT models about four months ago. But computer use is a significantly awesome thing no matter what model you use, and it is important that the industry similarly spends more effort to train their models to be great at computer use, among other elements of model capabilities.

As models become more capable and central to businesses and economies, the value of computer use only increases. We should be taking it seriously, and doing the right thing for our customers and the world.

text:
GPT-Image 2.5 本次最大的升级是超乎你想象的强大的可控编辑能力

就是你能完全精确控制图像哪里变哪里不变，而且只需要通过文字描述即可对图像进行非常精细和精准的编辑，可以说是完全替代 Photoshop 级别的更新...

分享个15个精准编辑场景提示词 Prompt都能直接复制：

1，多图分工合并

指定每张参考图各管一个部分，身份、服装、场景、构图分开来，最后合成一张。

"Image 1 = subject identity. Image 2 = outfit. Image 3 = setting. Image 4 = framing. Use each source only for its assigned role and merge them into one realistic scene."

2，锁定基准图

把某张图设为基准版本，之后每次改动只动你点名的那一处，其他全部锁死。

"Lock this image as the base version. Every attribute stays fixed unless I name it directly. On future edits, touch only the variable I mention, leave everything else exactly as is."

3，精准局部编辑

只改你指定的那一块，材质光线角度全部保持原样。

"Edit only the [ELEMENT] I specify. Keep the surrounding anatomy, material, lighting and angle untouched. Nothing else in the frame should change."

4，产品图直接放进完整场景

产品本身的形状材质颜色logo都不能变，只换背景光线和机位。

"Treat the uploaded product shot as fixed, exact shape, materials, color and branding. Drop it into [SCENE], only adjust the backdrop, light and camera angle."

5，批量做A/B测试素材

一次生成多个版本，只改你要测试的那一个变量，其余全部保持一致。

"Produce [N] versions of this creative. Keep product, layout, type and lighting identical across all of them. Vary only [ONE VARIABLE]."

6，改比例不裁切

换成新的画幅比例，靠智能扩展和重排来补全画面，而不是简单裁掉。

"Rebuild this image for [ASPECT RATIO] without cropping. Keep the subject and visual hierarchy, extend and rearrange the rest of the frame intelligently."

7，界面截图放进宣传图

上传的界面设计原样不动，直接嵌进一个高级设备或宣传场景里。

"Keep the uploaded interface exactly as designed, no redesign. Place it inside a premium [DEVICE/SETTING] scene with realistic reflections, lighting and negative space."

8，把平面图案印上实体产品

图案的构图颜色不变，按材质本身的褶皱和纹理规律真实地印上去。

"Take the artwork in image 1 exactly as is, same composition and colors. Apply it onto [PRODUCT] the way print actually behaves on that material, following its folds and texture."

9，分镜连续性

把这张图设为角色服装场景的基准，生成下一镜，只变机位构图和姿势。

"Use this as the fixed reference for character, outfit and location. Generate the next shot: [SHOT DESCRIPTION]. Only camera angle, framing and pose should change."

10，生成3D建模参考图

用一张图作为角色基准，生成指定视角的标准站姿全身图，用于建模参考。

"Use image 1 as the character reference. Generate a [VIEW] full body A pose version. Keep silhouette, proportions, materials and details matched, neutral studio light."

11，只换身上某一件衣服

人物姿势光线背景都不动，只换指定的那一件服装。

"Keep identity, pose, camera, lighting and background untouched. Replace only [GARMENT], using image 2 as reference for cut, material and color."

12，室内单一元素改造

房屋结构门窗机位全部保持原样，只改你指定的那一个元素。

"Keep architecture, dimensions, perspective, doors and windows exactly as shown. Change only [ELEMENT] to [NEW VERSION]."

13，文案本地化

产品构图光线不变，只替换画面里的文字内容，适配目标市场。

"Keep product, layout and lighting exactly as is. Replace only the visible text with '[NEW TEXT]', adjust background details minimally for [MARKET]. No extra text added."

14，草图变成精美信息图

每个节点和标签都保留，只优化排版间距和视觉层次。

"Turn this rough sketch into a clean [DIAGRAM/INFOGRAPHIC]. Keep every node, connection and label exactly as drawn. Only refine spacing, alignment and hierarchy."

15，电商图抠图清理

产品本身不动，去掉背景，只修复边缘细节，不动颜色形状和logo。

"Keep the product exactly as is. Remove the background, isolate it on [transparent/plain background]. Only clean up edge artifacts, no changes to color, shape or branding."

OpenAI 还在  API 中引入了两个新图像模型：  

GPT-Image-2.5 Flare 带来了相同的品质、编辑能力，但是生成速度更快  

GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst 为详细高要求创意工作带来更加精确度和高质量的图像，但生成时间更长

如果你没有API，想体验的话，在Higgsfield上都能用，这些Prompt可以直接拿自己的图去试。
